pages.title: Grévy's Zebra
pages.text: Grévy's zebra ($(o)Equus grevyi$()) is the largest living wild equid, found in the semi-arid grasslands and scrublands of Kenya and Ethiopia.$(br2)It is distinguished by its narrow, closely spaced stripes, white belly and large, rounded ears.$(br2)Grévy's zebra can go several days without drinking, and it is now endangered, with only a few thousand left in the wild.
